title: SpaceX CRS-23 Isolated Launch Views - 720p
description: SpaceX’s 23rd contracted cargo resupply services (CRS) mission to the International Space Station for NASA is delivering more than 4,800 pounds of science, research, and crew supplies to the orbital laboratory and its crew. Launch happened at 3:14 a.m. EDT Sunday, August 29, 2021. Coverage began at 2:45 a.m. and aired live on NASA Television, the NASA app, and the agency’s website.
keywords: NASA, Kennedy Space Center, Commercial Resupply Services, CRS-23, science, humans in space, ISS Program Research Office, CRS-23 launch coverage
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
